Package dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.currency

Interface CurrencyService

public interface CurrencyService
Provides currency queries for Zentrix games.

Use it to read player balances, currency configuration, and reward values, and since 1.8.0 to change balances with deposit(java.util.UUID, double, java.lang.String), withdraw(java.util.UUID, double, java.lang.String), setBalance(java.util.UUID, double, java.lang.String) and resetBalance(java.util.UUID, java.lang.String). Built-in rewards can be adjusted or withheld through CurrencyRewardEvent, and every committed change is reported by CurrencyTransactionEvent.

Example


 CurrencyService currencyService = ZentrixProvider.get().getCurrencyService();

 // Get the player's balance
 double balance = currencyService.getCachedBalance(player);

 // Format the balance
 String formatted = currencyService.formatBalance(balance);
 // Result: "⛃ 150"

 // Check an event reward
 double killReward = currencyService.getEventReward(CurrencyEventType.PLAYER_KILL);
Since:
1.0.0

    • deposit

      @NotNull default @NotNull CompletableFuture<CurrencyTransaction> deposit(@NotNull @NotNull UUID playerId, double amount, @NotNull @NotNull String source)
      Adds currency to a player's balance.

      The change goes through the same pipeline as Zentrix's own: it is queued behind the player's other changes, CurrencyChangeEvent fires before it is applied with reason ADDON and the given source, and the future completes with what was really committed. No message is sent to the player. Any thread; the future may complete on any thread.

      Parameters:
      playerId - The player's UUID; the player does not need to be online
      amount - The amount to add; must be positive and finite
      source - What the change is for, such as "myaddon:quest-reward"
      Returns:
      The committed change
      Since:
      1.8.0

    • withdraw

      @NotNull default @NotNull CompletableFuture<CurrencyTransaction> withdraw(@NotNull @NotNull UUID playerId, double amount, @NotNull @NotNull String source)
      Takes currency from a player's balance, only when they have at least that much.

      The balance is checked and changed as one step of the player's queue, so two withdrawals racing each other on this server can never take more than the player holds: one completes with CurrencyTransaction.Status.INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS and changes nothing. Otherwise it behaves like deposit(UUID, double, String).

      Parameters:
      playerId - The player's UUID
      amount - The amount to take; must be positive and finite
      source - What the change is for, such as "myaddon:shop"
      Returns:
      The committed change
      Since:
      1.8.0

    • getRewardMultiplier

      default double getRewardMultiplier(@NotNull org.bukkit.entity.Player player)
      The multiplier applied to the match rewards of gameplay/economy.yml this player earns, from their permission nodes such as zentrix.multiplier.1.5. The highest node applies; nodes do not stack.

      Only positive match rewards are multiplied, before CurrencyRewardEvent sees them. Penalties, administrator commands and addon transactions such as deposit(UUID, double, String) never are.

      Parameters:
      player - The player
      Returns:
      1.0 when the player has no multiplier node or multipliers are switched off
      Since:
      1.9.0
